resources.string: WorkManager audits remain active. Open the app to resume foreground symbol serving.
Your phone stores erasure-coded content shares that cannot reconstruct files alone. Public objects are public network data; sealed objects are end-to-end encrypted. No PoW mining runs on this device.

Owner spend key (ML-DSA-87, 24 words) requires biometric or PIN verification. Operator (ML-DSA-65) and BLS presence keys are wrapped by Android Keystore AES-256-GCM (StrongBox when available) without unlock gating so background audits succeed: physical device compromise can sign duty messages only and can never spend staked BUD.
Share local diagnostic log file? No third-party analytics SDK is used.
